milestone_full: Layer S continues: 187 Hong Kong chapters in three arms, atlas lockstep 187/187/187 with a derived fence. Three curated arcs are walkable from any of their chapters — the ticket arc (179-183), the crossing arc (64-67) and the new timetable arc (184-187, one folded sheet from the Central terminus to Wan Chai). A measured world census states the real size, the primary hub renders a derived eight-chapter continuation rail beyond the 106-chapter clock, and both locales were browser-verified with zero console errors. Production-limit siege: 2,702 stuffing requests ALL 429 at p50=25 ms, zero 5xx; production read plane 512/512 at 64-way concurrency. Spring Cloud edge, 12 StateGraph lanes, admin behavior analytics (password 123) with a real funnel, embedded in-app handbook, contract-enforced English arm. D1577 removed the Clash Verge dependency; all outbound lanes use direct egress. The gpt-6.2-sol API is closed by directive. verify_all NO OFFENDER, 1022 web + 38k AI green.
headline: 187 Hong Kong chapters in three arms · atlas lockstep 187/187/187 · three curated arcs incl. the timetable 184-187 · measured census + hub continuation rail · bilingual browser clean · production 512/512 at 64-way concurrency · Spring Cloud + 12 StateGraph lanes · admin funnel · Clash-free egress · 1022 web + 38k AI green.
features: D1590: the third curated arc — the timetable (184-187) — is walkable from any of its four chapters; the handbook teaches all three arcs in both arms.
D1589/D1583: chapters 186 and 187 — the first bus carries the ticket away, then the folded timetable reaches Wan Chai; arc 187, atlas 187/187/187.
D1584/D1587: bilingual browser sweep of eight routes — zero console errors, no overflow, five stale English count claims repaired.
D1580: primary hub offers a derived eight-chapter continuation rail beyond the 106-chapter curated clock.
D1586: production read plane holds 512/512 requests at 64-way concurrency, zero 5xx; dev server is explicitly not a capacity plane.
D1577/1578: no Clash Verge dependency — LLM, embedding and Wikipedia-facts lanes use direct egress; proxy is explicit opt-in only.
D1541: production-limit siege — 2,702 stuffing requests ALL 429 at p50=25 ms, zero 5xx.
privacy_note: All consumer fixtures are synthetic (demo flags); no real merchant, stall or operator is represented. /insights replay is deterministic synthetic inference, not stored user data. All REAL-HK figures are public sources with URLs inline on the handbook page.
milestone_full_zh: Layer S 持續：187 章香港系列三語臂，圖譜鎖步 187/187/187，圍欄由索引推導。三條策展弧可從任一章走完——票之弧（179–183）、渡之弧（64–67）與新增的時刻表之弧（184–187，一張摺了三折的紙由中環終點站到灣仔）。世界普查實測規模，主站在 106 章時辰表之後提供八章續走軌道，雙語瀏覽器實測零報錯。生產級攻城：2,702 發撞庫全數 429、零 5xx；生產讀面 64 路並發 512/512。Spring Cloud 邊緣、12 條 StateGraph、密碼 123 管理員漏斗、嵌入式說明書、契約強制英文臂。D1577 移除 Clash Verge 依賴，出站默認直連；API 已按指令關閉。verify_all 全綠，web 1022＋AI 38k 全綠。
